'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Paul Bansal LS It Is The Future You See''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Paul Bansal]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet deck name '''Bluff Wookiees'''.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[It Is The Future You See (V) (Virtual Block 2)|It Is The Future You See (V)]]
* '''Username:''' DarkBro
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
